project.title: Cloud Services Directorate, Cloud Platform Engineering Project
project.role: AWS Cloud Infrastructure as Code DevOps Engineer & Architect

parentsummary.deliverables: Designed, coded, and deployed the SSC CSD Landing Zone as reusable Infrastructure as Code, integrating AWS Landing Zone customization, ASEA Security Guard Rails, SSO federation with Azure Active Directory, AWS IAM access control frameworks, CI/CD pipeline via CodePipeline and GitLab, and ITSG-22/33/38 and TBS cloud guardrail-aligned security controls to achieve iATO — supporting onboarding of critical government workloads including SCED, DX, Vocalls, and Email.
parentsummary.outcomes: Became the first SSC team to achieve ATO status using the AWS Secure Environment Accelerator, establishing the CSD Landing Zone as the reusable standard architecture for government-wide SSC cloud deployments and successfully onboarding multiple critical government workloads onto the compliant platform.

challenge.summary: The CSD R&D Project group are focused on generating a set of deployable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for re-use within SSC and partners. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) supports automation of 'CSD Landing Zone' integrating AWS Landing Zone customisation, SAA Security Guard Rails, and generic multi-purpose tools. Developed and drove success and security achievements to ATO with AWS Secure Environment Accelerator.

deliverables: Needs analysis, define requirements, and strategize architecture with AWS team
Architectural design and Proof of Concept (PoC) implementation for design review sessions
Implementation of IT Security Program to meet ITSG-22, ITSG-33 and ITSG-38 and TBS driven cloud guardrails and achieve iATO
Design, secure and implementation of SSO Federation with Azure Active Directory
Designed and codified the AWS IAM access control framework for the CSD Landing Zone
Facilitated requirements gathering with technical team, architecture team, and security team
Client Deployment of AWS Native resources to provide governance and generate iATO evidence packages
DevOps integration with DevOps tooling, methodology, and processes
Documentation, Knowledge transfer and cross-training with team, new staff and onboarded clients
Achieve ATO status for AWS Cloud
Supporting onboarding of workloads (SCED, DX, Vocalls, Email)

outcomes: ✅ First team to achieve ATO status using AWS Secure Environment Accelerator (ASEA), establishing reusable Infrastructure as Code templates for government-wide adoption
✅ Created foundational 'CSD Landing Zone' architecture that became the standard for SSC cloud deployments, supporting critical workloads including SCED, DX, and Email systems
